name: sophos-central-mcp
description: The Sophos Central partner, organization and tenant APIs, routed to the right tenant and region automatically, plus a cross-tenant triage queue, fleet tamper remediation, a multi-tenant SIEM collector and hostname-based containment.

sophos_central_client_id.title: SOPHOS_CENTRAL_CLIENT_ID
sophos_central_client_id.description: Client ID of a Sophos Central API credential (Partner Dashboard > Settings & Policies > API Credentials, or Global Settings > API Credentials Management).

sophos_central_client_secret.title: SOPHOS_CENTRAL_CLIENT_SECRET
sophos_central_client_secret.description: Client secret of that API credential. Sophos shows it only once, when the credential is created.

sophos_central_tenant_id.title: Customer tenant (optional)
sophos_central_tenant_id.description: Optional. With a partner or organization credential, the customer tenant ID that tenant-scoped tools act on. Leave blank to let the fleet tools walk every customer; tools that take a tenant argument can still pick one per call.

sophos_central_base_url.title: Sophos Central API base URL
sophos_central_base_url.description: Optional. Leave blank: requests go to https://api.central.sophos.com and each tenant's regional host is found automatically.

sophos_central_oauth_scope.title: OAuth2 scope
sophos_central_oauth_scope.description: Optional. Leave blank to use the scope Sophos Central documents (token).

sophos_central_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
sophos_central_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to 1 to make the MCP server refuse every non-GET call and hide the sync and export tools. It does not replace giving the API credential a read-only role.

sophos_central_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
sophos_central_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment); callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport Claude Desktop uses.

sophos_central_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
sophos_central_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to Sophos Central. Leave blank to use the built-in one.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only used when the MCP server is bound to a tenant-gated client profile. This connector registers no tenant-gated source, so leave it blank.
